$comment: Evidence-backed corrections applied after stable app price ids are assigned and before postcode-coordinate quarantine. Raw scrape artifacts remain unchanged. Every listed id must exist and exactly match the recorded identity or the build fails.

match.pubName: The Sir Michael Balcon - JD Wetherspoon

changes.pub_key: The Sir Michael Balcon - JD Wetherspoon51.5136177

corrections.reason: Official Wetherspoons identity and committed OpenStreetMap node 1117274890 both place this named venue at 46-47 The Mall, Ealing W5 3TJ. The scraped coordinates point at Whitehall.

evidence.finding: Official venue page identifies The Sir Michael Balcon at 46-47 The Mall, Ealing W5 3TJ.
OpenStreetMap node 1117274890 records the same name and postcode at 51.5136177, -0.2988011.

corrections.reason: The source row names White Bear at SE11 4DJ, which is 138 Kennington Park Road, Kennington. Its scraped coordinates are the point of the other White Bear, 57 St John Street, Farringdon EC1M 4AN, 3.8 km away, so the Kennington prices drew as a second Farringdon pin.

evidence.finding: OpenStreetMap way 539369586 records The White Bear at 138 Kennington Park Road, London SE11 4DJ, at 51.4868645, -0.1080348, with the website whitebearkennington.co.uk.
OpenStreetMap way 147495191 records White Bear at 57 St John Street, London EC1M 4AN, at 51.5211978, -0.1017737, the point the scraped SE11 4DJ row carries.

The source keys these prices to the pub URL https://www.pint-prices.com/pub/SE11%204DJ/White%20Bear, while the Farringdon pub has its own URL under 57 St John St, London EC1M 4AN with its own Mahou price.
